nodes.rationale: Frontier expert-level benchmark from 100 Physical Review Letters papers covering five physics subfields with exploration-oriented formulation, long-horizon workflows, and objective verifiability

nodes.label: Exploration-Oriented Task Design
nodes.rationale: Tasks provide scientific motivation and concrete objective while keeping solution pathways implicit, requiring autonomous planning and information integration

nodes.label: Error Type Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Categorizes failures into formulaic/conceptual errors, derivation errors, calculation errors, and incomplete responses
